title: Design-Build for Wauchula Municipal Airport - Fuel Farm/Generator
short_description: Design-build airport fuel farm and backup generator installation in Wauchula, Florida.
project_scope: Design-build project at Wauchula Municipal Airport comprising a new fuel farm and backup power system. The fuel farm includes design, permitting, supply, installation, construction, testing, and training for one new double-wall steel 12,000-gallon AVGAS tank and one new double-wall steel 12,000-gallon Jet-A tank on an existing concrete apron, plus an electrical backup engine generator set.
services: Design-build services including design, permitting, provision, installation, construction, testing, and training; disciplines requested include civil, environmental, electrical, mechanical, and utility engineering, plus construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Airport fuel farm and generator project, not a bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special lightweight structure.
- Focus is on tanks, utilities, and MEP-related infrastructure rather than structural engineering of interest to sbp.
- No indication of architecturally demanding, long-span, or innovative structural design.
- Design-build format includes planning, but the technical scope is outside sbp's core target sectors.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information for estimation: two new double-wall steel fuel tanks of 12,000 gallons each, installation on existing concrete apron, permitting, testing, training, and one electrical backup engine generator set at a municipal airport. Based on comparable small airport fuel farm and generator projects, a rough order-of-magnitude could be in the low single-digit millions USD, but this cannot be derived reliably from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because the tender is design-build and outside sbp's core structural scope, no reliable sbp fee estimate can be derived from the source alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified contractors for design-build services; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, construction/project management, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and utility engineering.
